defect: The fix drops the C++17-only DEFAULT_CA_CERT_FILE member (inline static const string) and initialises ca_cert_file with an empty literal so httpfs builds below C++17.
reason: The DEFAULT_CA_CERT_FILE default was already unbuildable for C++11 before this change (std::string_view in b6fcc4a, then constexpr string in 913798e); this change only swapped one non-C++11 form for another and renamed string to std::string, so the defect predates it.

defect: The format commit rewrote make_unique<LogicalEmptyResult>(move(op)) as make_unique_base<LogicalEmptyResult>(move(op)), but make_unique_base takes two template parameters (base, derived), so T cannot be deduced and the file does not compile.
reason: The fix reverts exactly this changed line to make_unique, repairing a compile failure introduced by this change; the odd one-argument make_unique_base next to identical make_unique calls is visible in the diff.

defect: BindFunction now returns a recoverable BindResult error after it has already moved the bound children out of function.children, so an outer binder (correlated subquery) retries the expression with null child expressions and crashes (issue 3351).
reason: The fix restores the throw on exactly the line this change turned into a return and adds a test for the null-pointer crash; seeing it requires knowing that error BindResults are retried by outer binders and already-bound children are skipped.

defect: The new AllNewLine helper returns true for an empty value, so at the end of the file an empty (e.g. quoted empty) last value of a single-column CSV is skipped instead of being added as a row.
reason: Before this change the final value was always added; the fix makes AllNewLine return false for an empty value in a one-column file, repairing the vacuous-truth case of the function this change added.

defect: CSVBuffer::Next now stops when file_handle.FinishedReading() is true, but FinishedReading compares requested decompressed bytes with the on-disk (compressed) file size, so compressed CSV files stop being read early and are truncated.
reason: The fix removes this FinishedReading early return and instead stops only when a read returns zero bytes (Fix for compressed files); seeing the defect needs csv_file_handle.hpp and the compressed file system's GetFileSize.

defect: The fix resets the compression state in SetOutputBuffer, encodes equal values (xor 0, which gave a shift by 64 and a zero byte count colliding with the 3-bit wrap of 8) as byte_count 1, and decodes byte_count 0 as 8 bytes.
reason: The repaired faults sit in compression code written before this WIP commit (SetOutputBuffer, significant_bits and the xor shift were unchanged context or only gained the template keyword); the decode lines this change added are only rewritten, and their own bit/byte and XOR errors were fixed by an intermediate commit.

defect: The commit removed has_format and made the CSV writer test the read format (dialect_options.date_format[...].Empty(), via the new StrpTimeFormat::Empty) instead of write_date_format, so COPY TO ignores a user dateformat/timestampformat.
reason: The fix moves Empty() from StrpTimeFormat to the base StrTimeFormat so copy_csv.cpp can check write_date_format, repairing the write path this commit broke; the defect itself is in copy_csv.cpp of the same commit, not visible from this file.

defect: CSVComplexFilterPushdown unconditionally builds a column map with data->options.names[get.column_ids[i]], which indexes out of bounds when column_ids holds the row-id sentinel (e.g. count(*) scans, since pushdown is called even without filters).
reason: The fix, the same day by the same author, guards the map building with the hive/filename options and uses get.names, repairing the out-of-bounds names lookup this change added; it needs LogicalGet::ResolveTypes and PushdownGet to see.

defect: The new loop that skips empty files constructs CSVFileScan for files[++cur_file_idx] with file_idx 0U, so later files are treated as file 0 (reusing the initial reader and file 0's column info, and Next() computing the next file from the wrong index).
reason: The fix passes cur_file_idx on exactly this added line; the hard-coded 0U while iterating over later files is visible in the diff next to the file 0 call.

defect: With arrow_large_buffer_size the MAP appender writes 64-bit offsets (ArrowMapData<int64_t>), but Arrow has no large map type and the schema still says +m with 32-bit offsets, so exported maps are corrupted.
reason: The fix removes the large-offset MAP branch this change added and always uses int32 offsets, with a test for both settings; the mismatch needs the schema code in arrow_converter.cpp or Arrow spec knowledge.

defect: The warning fix computes static_cast<double>(source.count * target.count), an unsigned 64-bit product that can overflow before the cast (previously evaluated in double), and keeps the combined count as a double assigned back to the uint64 count.
reason: The fix restores an integer count with an overflow check and multiplies the double-converted counts, repairing both changes this commit made to Combine; the integer multiplication inside the cast is visible in the diff.
